SMB.c(36):     \tfunction readAnalyticsCookie(name) {\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t    var cName = encodeURIComponent(name) + "=";\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t    var cv = document.cookie.split(';');\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t    for (var i = 0; i < cv.length; i++) {\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t        var c = cv[i];\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t        while (c.charAt(0) === ' ')\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t            c = c.substring(1, c.length);\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t        if (c.indexOf(cName) === 0)\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t            return decodeURIComponent(c.substring(cName.length, c.length));\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t    }\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t    return null;\r\n
SMB.c(36):     \t}\r\n
